notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Hornet Queen and Slimefoot and Squee, adding two mana in any combination of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Hornet Queen from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hornet Queen and Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Hornet Queen trigger, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing two Insects, Hornet Queen and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
